description: Effective Number of Codons (Wright 1990 Nc, CodonW enc_out conventions) for a coding sequence under the standard genetic code: 20..61, or 0 when Nc cannot be calculated (a synonymous class other than the single 3-fold Ile class has no estimable amino acid).

enc.description: Effective Number of Codons, 20..61 (20 = extreme bias, 61 = no bias); 0 = not calculable (CodonW *****).

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
